**पॉलीहाऊसमध्ये आच्छादन साहित्याचे वापराचे सर्वोत्तम साहित्य:**

पॉलीहाऊसमध्ये आच्छादन साहित्याचा वापर करताना, खालील विविध साहित्य वापरता येऊ शकते:

1. **प्लास्टिक आच्छादन (Plastic Mulch):**  
   - हे साहित्य पॉलीहाऊसमध्ये वापरले जाते आणि ते वातावरण नियंत्रित करते.  
   - यामुळे मातीचे तापमान आणि आर्द्रता नियंत्रित होते, ज्यामुळे फुलांचे वाढ आणि उत्पादन वाढते.  
   - प्लास्टिक आच्छादनची मोटाई 40 ते 100 मायक्रॉन असावी.  

2. **ऊसचा कचरा (Sugarcane Trash):**  
   - ऊसचा कचरा आच्छादन म्हणून वापरला जातो.  
   - हे वातावरण नियंत्रित करते आणि मातीचे तापमान वाढते.  
   - ऊसचा कचरा आणि गहूची तांदूळ आच्छादन म्हणून वापरले जाते.  

3. **गांडूळखत (Vermicompost):**  
   - गांडूळखत आच्छादन म्हणून वापरले जाते.  
   - हे खनिज आणि पोषक तत्वांचे स्रोत असते आणि मातीच्या गुणवत्तेचे सुधारणे करते.  

4. **हरितगृहात फुलशेतीसाठी आच्छादन (Floriculture Mulch):**  
   - फुलशेतीसाठी आच्छादन वापरले जाते.  
   - यामध्ये कार्नेशन, जरबेरा, अंथुरियम आणि आर्किड यांच्यासाठी विशिष्ट आच्छादन साहित्य वापरले जाते.  

5. **मृदा आच्छादन (Soil Mulch):**  
   - मृदा आच्छादन म्हणजे मातीचे उपरी भाग आच्छादित करणे.  
   - हे आर्द्रता आणि तापमान नियंत्रित करते.  

### आच्छादन साहित्याचा वापराचे फायदे:
- आच्छादन साहित्याचा वापर करताना, फुलांच्या वाढीची दर वाढते.  
- मातीचे तापमान आणि आर्द्रता नियंत्रित राहते.  
- फुलांच्या उत्पादनाचे वाढते.  
- आच्छादन साहित्य आपल्या पॉलीहाऊसमध्ये उत्पादनाच्या गुणवत्तेचे सुधारणे करते.

**पावसापासून संरक्षण निवारा (Rainout Shelter for Crop Protection):**

पावसापासून पीकांचे संरक्षण करण्यासाठी शेततळे (farm ponds) वापर करता येते. हे शेततळे पावसाळा दरम्यान विसर्गाचे पाणी जमा करून शेतीच्या अतिरिक्त सिंचनासाठी वापरता येते. यामुळे शेतकऱ्यांना निश्चित सिंचनाच्या सुविधा मिळतात आणि दुष्काळाच्या परिस्थितीतही शेतीची उत्पादकता बर्खास्त होत नाही.

### शेततळे बांधण्याचे उद्देश:
1. दुष्काळ आणि हवामान बदलांच्या परिस्थितीत शेतकऱ्यांना सुरक्षित सिंचनाची सुविधा उपलब्ध करून देणे.
2. शेतीच्या उत्पादकतेत सुधारणा करणे.
3. शेतकऱ्यांची आयत व जीवन स्तर वाढवणे.
4. उद्यानविद्या, आंबा लावणे, पिसिकल्चर, आणि पशुपालन यांसारख्या अतिरिक्त शेती उत्पादनांचा प्रोत्साहन देणे.
5. पाणी संसाधन संरक्षणाद्वारे जमिनीच्या जलस्तरात सुधारणा करणे.

### शेततळे बांधण्याचे उपाय:
- पावसाळा दरम्यान विसर्गाचे पाणी शेततळ्यात जमा करा.
- शेततळ्यात एक निश्चित पाणी आहे जे शेतीच्या आवश्यकतेनुसार वापरता येते.
- शेततळ्याच्या बांधकामाच्या विविध तत्वांचा विचार करा, जसे की पाणी जमा करणे, पाणी नियंत्रण, आणि निर्माणाची अतिरिक्त सुविधा.

### शेततळे बांधण्याची आवश्यकता:
- शेततळे बांधण्यासाठी शेतकऱ्यांना विविध सहाय्य उपलब्ध करून देणे आवश्यक आहे, जसे की वित्तीय सहाय्य, तंत्रज्ञान आणि प्रशिक्षण.
- शेततळे बांधण्यासाठी शेतकऱ्यांच्या सहभागाची आवश्यकता आहे आणि त्यांना योग्य तंत्रज्ञान आणि प्रशिक्षण उपलब्ध करून देणे आवश्यक आहे.

**स्रोत: NDKSP Phase 2 Individual Farm Pond Guidelines**

1. **उत्तम चारा आणि पाणी पुरवठा:** गाईंना उत्तम गुणवत्तेचा चारा आणि पुरेसे पाणी पुरवा. चारा आणि पाण्याची गुणवत्ता वाढवून दूधाची उत्पादन क्षमता वाढते.

2. **स्वच्छता आणि आरोग्य व्यवस्थापन:** गाईंची स्वच्छता राखा आणि आवश्यक वेळी डॉक्टरांचा सल्ला घ्या. रोग आणि अपचाय दूर करून दूधाची उत्पादन क्षमता वाढते.

answer:
**मास्टाइटिसचे नियंत्रण उच्च उत्पादक गाईमध्ये:**

मास्टाइटिस हा दुधाच्या उत्पादनावर प्रभाव पाडणारा आजार आहे, ज्यामुळे गाईच्या दुधाची गुणवत्ता आणि मात्रा घटते. खाली उच्च उत्पादक गाईमध्ये मास्टाइटिसचे नियंत्रण करण्यासाठी उपाय दिले आहेत:

### 1. **स्वच्छता आणि व्यवस्थापन:**
- **मिळावे यंत्र आणि थनांची स्वच्छता:** मिळावे यंत्र आणि गाईच्या थनांची नियमितपणे स्वच्छता करा. मिळावे यंत्रांची नियमित तपासणी आणि स्वच्छता बरोबर ठेवा.
- **मिळावे आधी आणि नंतर थनांची विषाणू नाशक वापर करा:** मिळावे आधी आणि नंतर थनांची विषाणू नाशक वापर करून विषाणूच्या संसर्गाचा रोखा.
- **स्वच्छ गादी आणि निवारा:** गाईंच्या गादी आणि निवारा स्वच्छ ठेवा. गादीच्या स्वच्छतेच्या बाबतीत बांधकाम आणि गादीची नियमित बदल करा.
- **हवामान आणि तापमान नियंत्रण:** गाईंच्या निवारा मध्ये उष्णतेचा ताण कमी करण्यासाठी उच्च तापमान आणि आवाजाचा नियंत्रण करा.

### 2. **मिळावे आणि थनांची देखभाल:**
- **मिळावे यंत्राची बरोबर तपासणी:** मिळावे यंत्राची बरोबर तपासणी आणि नियमित बरोबर वापर करा.
- **थनांची नियमित तपासणी:** गाईच्या थनांची नियमित तपासणी करा आणि जखम अथवा विषाणूच्या संसर्गाचा रोखा.
- **थनांचे बंद ठेवणे:** मिळावे नंतर थनांचे बंद ठेवणे आवश्यक आहे, जेणेकरून विषाणूच्या संसर्गाचा रोखा.

### 3. **वैद्यकीय उपचार आणि लसीकरण:**
- **वैद्यकीय उपचार:** जर गाई मास्टाइटिसच्या लक्षणांना बरोबर असेल तर त्वरित वैद्यकीय उपचारांचा वापर करा.
- **लसीकरण:** मास्टाइटिस आणि अन्य आजारांचे नियंत्रण करण्यासाठी लसीकरण उपयोगी आहे. विशेषतः *Staphylococcus aureus*, *Escherichia coli*, आणि *Mycoplasma bovis* यांच्या विरुद्धचे लसी वापर करा.

### 4. **स्वच्छ आणि नियमित खाद्य आणि पाणी:**
- **गाईंना उत्तम खाद्य आणि पाणी पुरवा:** गाईंना नियमितपणे उत्तम खाद्य आणि पाणी पुरवा. खाद्याची गुणवत्ता आणि पाण्याची स्वच्छता खास करून लक्षात ठेवा.

### 5. **मास्टाइटिसचे नियंत्रण आणि जागरूकता:**
- **मास्टाइटिसचे नियंत्रण आणि जागरूकता:** गाईंच्या निवारा मध्ये मास्टाइटिसचे नियंत्रण आणि जागरूकता वाढवा. नियमितपणे गाईंच्या दुधाची चाचणी करून आजाराचे नियंत्रण करा.

### 6. **उच्च उत्पादक गाईंची विशेष काळजी:**
- **उच्च उत्पादक गाईंची विशेष काळजी:** उच्च उत्पादक गाईंच्या विशेष काळजीची आवश्यकता असते. त्यांच्या आरोग्याची नियमित तपासणी आणि आवश्यक उपचार करा.

### 7. **संकरी गाईंची विशेष काळजी:**
- **संकरी गाईंची विशेष काळजी:** संकरी गाईंच्या आरोग्याची नियमित तपासणी करा. त्यांच्या आरोग्याची देखभाल आणि नियमित उपचार करा.

### 8. **मास्टाइटिसचे नियंत्रण आणि जागरूकता:**
- **मास्टाइटिसचे नियंत्रण आणि जागरूकता:** गाईंच्या निवारा मध्ये मास्टाइटिसचे नियंत्रण आणि जागरूकता वाढवा. नियमितपणे गाईंच्या दुधाची चाचणी करून आजाराचे नियंत्रण करा.

A. ACUTE MASTITIS [स्तनदाह]

It is the severe inflammation of udder [कास] where physical [शारीरिक तपासणी] changes are clearly visible in udder [कास] and milk [दूध]. High yielding animals are more prone. Mainly caused by bacteria [जीवाणू] (more than 100 types). Also caused by fungi, virus & rarely by algae.

Prevention [प्रतिबंध] of clinical mastitis [स्तनदाह] in cattle [गाय वर्ग] is essentially identical to that for subclinical mastitis [स्तनदाह], ie, decreasing microbe exposure to the teats. Because most clinical mastitis [स्तनदाह] is caused by pathogens that are predominantly environmental in origin, decreasing exposure from bedding [गादी], housing [निवास व्यवस्था], and in outdoor lots and pastures is critical. However, good premilking hygiene [स्वच्छता] to ensure teats are clean and dry [कोरडे] before the attachment of the milking [दूध काढणे] unit, including use of germicides (premilking teat [थन] dips), is beneficial.

With the exception of bacterins that target gram [हरभरा]-negative pathogens, particularly coliforms, immunization to decrease the effects of mastitis [स्तनदाह] has been largely unsuccessful or, at best, variable. Core-antigen technology based on J5 mutant *E coli* can help decrease the severity of clinical mastitis [स्तनदाह] caused by coliforms. Immunization with these bacterins should include multiple doses during the dry [कोरडे] period to decrease the incidence of clinical coliform mastitis [स्तनदाह] frequently associated with early lactation. Protocols for extended numbers of immunizations of these bacterins may be warranted in herds with high rates of severe mastitis [स्तनदाह] beyond 60 days in milk [दूध] because protection often wanes 5060 days after the last immunization.

It is important to note that these bacterins decrease the severity of clinical mastitis [स्तनदाह] cases caused by gram [हरभरा]-negative pathogens only and that while the severity of clinical signs can be decreased, these bacterins do not prevent infections.

The success of core-antigen bacterins relies on five fundamental principles:

- 1. Validate that coliform organisms are the primary cause of severe clinical mastitis [स्तनदाह] in a herd [पशूंचे झुंड] by culture of milk [दूध] samples.

question: गायीला ताप आणि खाणे बंद झाले आहे, काय करावे?
answer:
आपल्या गायीला ताप आणि खाणे बंद झाले असेल तर हे गंभीर प्रश्न असू शकतो. खालील उपाय करा:

1. **ताप नियंत्रण करा:**
   - गायीला थंड ठिकाणी ठेवा आणि थंड पाणी पिण्याची व्यवस्था करा.
   - ताप असलेल्या गायीला विशेष दवा देण्यासाठी तात्काळ वैद्यकीय मदत घ्या. एखादा वैद्य अथवा शेती अधिकारी याबाबत मार्गदर्शन करू शकतो.

2. **खाणे बंद झाले असल्यास:**
   - गायीला विशेष खाद्य आणि पाणी पुरवा. जर गाय खाणे बंद केले असेल तर ती अस्वस्थ असू शकते, त्यामुळे तात्काळ वैद्यकीय मदत घ्या.
   - गायीचे वजन आणि आरोग्य तपासा. जर ती खाणे बंद केले असेल तर ती बीमार असू शकते.

question: Can I replace soybean meal with crushed cottonseed in my poultry feed today

कृपया आपल्या शेती विज्ञान केंद्रात जाऊन आपल्या खोरक्याचे घटक बदलण्याची सल्ला घ्या.

question: Paramparik nangaracha tulanet phirtya kulavache fayde konte ahet?
answer:
आपण जे प्रश्न विचारले आहे, ते "पारंपरिक नांगर आणि कुलवा च्या फायद्याबद्दल" आहे. याचे अधिक तपशील देण्यासाठी, मी योग्य शब्दांचा वापर करून तपशील शोधत आहे.

1. पारंपरिक नांगर चे फायदे:
   - नांगर शेतीच्या विविध प्रकारांमध्ये वापरला जातो आणि तो शेती आणि खेतीच्या प्रक्रियेत महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका बजावतो.
   - तो शेतकऱ्यांना जमीन खोदण्याच्या आवश्यकता नसताना खेतांत तयार करण्यास मदत करतो.
   - नांगर शेती आणि खेतीच्या परंपरा आणि ज्ञानाचा एक भाग आहे.

2. कुलवा चे फायदे:
   - कुलवा हे एक विशिष्ट प्रकारचे फळ आहे जे आपल्या शरीरासाठी उपयोगी आहे.
   - ते आपल्या आरोग्यासाठी उपयोगी आहे आणि त्वचा, वजन आणि शरीराच्या अन्य अवयवांच्या विकासासाठी उपयोगी आहे.
   - ते एक उत्तम दाल आहे आणि शेतकऱ्यांना विविध प्रकारचे फळ उत्पादन करण्यास मदत करते.

हे फायदे आपल्या शेती आणि खेती च्या विविध प्रकारांमध्ये अत्यंत महत्वाचे आहेत. आपण जे शेती करत आहात त्यासाठी या विषयांचा अधिक अभ्यास करू शकता. 

**स्रोत: शेती आणि खेती च्या विषयांची माहिती**

question: Aata makka vikava ki kahi divas thambava?
answer:
आवळा मावा (Indian Gooseberry Aphid) हे आवळा पिकावर झालेले एक अत्यंत नुकसानकारक कीट होते. ते आवळा पालेभाज्यांवर आढळतात आणि त्यांच्या वाढीला अडथळा निर्माण करतात. खालील उपाय आवळा मावा नियंत्रित करण्यास मदत करतात:

1. **कीटनाशक वापर:** आवळा मावा नियंत्रित करण्यासाठी, एम्फोसिड (Emamectin Benzoate) किंवा इतर विशेष उपाय वापरता येऊ शकतात. यासाठी शेतकऱ्यांनी कृषी विज्ञान केंद्रातून (KVK) मार्गदर्शन घेणे आवश्यक आहे.

2. **जमीन झाडांची चाचणी:** आवळा मावा नियंत्रित करण्यासाठी, जमीन झाडांची नियमित चाचणी करा. जर आवळा मावा नियंत्रित करण्यासाठी अतिरिक्त उपाय आवश्यक असेल तर त्यासाठी कृषी विज्ञान केंद्रातून मदत घ्या.

3. **शेतात जंगली झाडे नष्ट करा:** आवळा मावा जंगली झाडांवर अधिक वाढतो, त्यामुळे त्यांच्यावर नियंत्रण ठेवणे आवश्यक आहे.

4. **उत्पादनाची देखरेख करा:** आवळा पिकाची नियमित देखरेख करा आणि जर आवळा मावा नियंत्रित करण्यासाठी अतिरिक्त उपाय आवश्यक असेल तर त्यासाठी कृषी विज्ञान केंद्रातून मदत घ्या.

**स्रोत: आवळा मावा नियंत्रण दस्तऐवज**

agristack_workflow.evidence: This is an eligibility query (“मी कोणत्या योजनेसाठी पात्र आहे?”) with Agristack ✅, but the assistant neither fetched Agristack data nor personalized based on PoCRA/caste/land. It only listed schemes.

term_identification.evidence: N/A - The user asked a broad eligibility question, not about a specific advisory or single scheme term to identify.

tool_sequencing.evidence: It called get_scheme_codes but stopped there. For eligibility, expected flow is fetch_agristack_data → get_scheme_codes → get_scheme_info/get_multiple_schemes_info with personalized assessment. No follow-up scheme_info calls were made.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search was required or performed for this scheme listing use case.

output_hygiene.evidence: No internal tool names or JSON leaked. However, the response is a raw long list without structured personalization, which mildly impacts hygiene/UX.

source_alignment.evidence: The scheme codes largely align with the tool’s list, but several Marathi names are mistranslated (e.g., “प्रक्षेपण सिंचन” for sprinkler, “गाई पालन” for goat rearing, “व्यक्तिगत खोली” for farm ponds), risking minor misalignment in meaning though codes match.

no_fabrication.evidence: No invented benefits/eligibility/contacts/timelines. The content is limited to listing schemes from tool output.

citation_accuracy.evidence: No citation provided. Expected: “स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती” for scheme information responses.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No agronomic dosages or chemicals were advised.

completeness.evidence: Does not answer “which schemes am I eligible for?”; provides an exhaustive list without checking eligibility (PoCRA, caste, landholding) or summarizing benefits/requirements.

actionability.evidence: No portal URL, documents list, or application steps. Only asks the user to choose a scheme (“आपण कोणती योजना विशेष विचारू इच्छिता?”).

context_fit.evidence: Agristack was available but unused; no PoCRA status check or category-based personalization, so context was not applied.

clarity.evidence: State vs central sections are separated, but many mistranslations (e.g., ‘खोली’ for ‘pond’) reduce clarity; the very long list can overwhelm.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a generic prompt to choose a scheme but does not propose relevant categories based on likely needs or offer to fetch personalized eligibility.

grammar.evidence: Generally understandable, but several titles are awkward or incorrect (e.g., “वर्षा वाला” mix and inconsistent noun usage).

terminology.evidence: Incorrect agricultural/official terms in multiple places: ‘प्रक्षेपण सिंचन’ (should be ‘स्प्रिंकलर सिंचन’), ‘गाई पालन’ (should be ‘शेळी पालन’ for goat rearing), ‘खोली’ used for ‘pond’ instead of ‘तलाव/खोदकाम/फार्म पाँड’.

language_purity.evidence: Mostly Marathi with acceptable scheme acronyms (PMFBY, MIDH), but some awkward Hindi/English mixing like “वर्षा वाला” and “कृषिनती” diminishes purity.

fluency.evidence: Reads like a raw dump of items; several unnatural phrases and inconsistent translations make it stilted for a rural Marathi context.

evaluation.summary: The response only lists many schemes without using Agristack for eligibility personalization and lacks a source citation. Multiple mistranslations and absence of actionable guidance reduce usefulness for the farmer.

10. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp) - बांबू (Bamboo)** - एनडीकेएसपी-एग्रोफॉरेस्ट्री-बॅम्बू
11. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp) - बागायत (Horticulture Plantation)** - एनडीकेएसपी-हॉर्टिकल्चर-प्लांटेशन
12. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp) - शेत तलाव (Individual Farm Ponds)** - एनडीकेएसपी-इंडिविज्युअल-फार्म-पॉंड्स
13. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakalp) - अंडर (Pump Set)** - एनडीकेएसपी-पंप-सेट

17. **नानाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प (Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Prakल्प) - अंडर (Inland Fishery)** - एनडीकेएसपी-इंलॅंड-फिशरी

agristack_workflow.evidence: Agristack was unavailable (❌) and the agent did not attempt to fetch it; for a general scheme info query this is acceptable. However, it failed to tailor results to the user's livestock context.

term_identification.evidence: User asked specifically for 'पशुपालनासाठी' schemes, but the response listed many unrelated crop/horticulture/mechanization schemes. Only a few livestock/allied ones (e.g., 'ndksp-goat-rearing', 'ndksp-sericulture-unit', 'ndksp-inland-fishery') were included among many irrelevant items.

tool_sequencing.evidence: The agent used get_scheme_codes first (correct). It did not proceed to get_scheme_info/get_multiple_schemes_info for livestock-relevant schemes, reducing usefulness but not breaking workflow.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search was required or performed for scheme info.

output_hygiene.evidence: The reply leaked internal tool usage: 'उदा., आपण `get_scheme_info("mahadbt-pmkisan")`...' which exposes tool names. Also several malformed scheme code transliterations (e.g., 'महाद्बत-पीएमएफबीई').

source_alignment.evidence: Many scheme names loosely align with the tool list, but with errors and mismatches (e.g., 'राष्ट्रीय तेल तेल तेल तेल योजना' garbled; codes like 'महाद्बत-बमक्य' not matching exact tool codes). Also included broad lists without confirming livestock relevance.

no_fabrication.evidence: No benefits/eligibility/timelines were invented; however, multiple mistransliterations and garbled names reduce reliability though not outright fabrication.

citation_accuracy.evidence: No source citation provided. Expected: 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती' for scheme responses.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No chemical dosages or safety-sensitive advice provided.

completeness.evidence: Did not present a focused list of animal husbandry schemes. Missed key livestock categories (dairy, poultry, fodder, veterinary services). Overloaded with unrelated crop/horticulture items.

actionability.evidence: No portal link (MahaDBT), no documents list, no eligibility or application steps. Asking the user to pick a scheme and referencing internal tool is not actionable for farmers.

context_fit.evidence: Query was livestock-specific; response wasn't filtered to that context and included mostly non-livestock schemes. No personalization (Agristack ❌, but still could context-fit to livestock).

clarity.evidence: Numerous linguistic/formatting issues: repeated/garbled entries, awkward labels like 'अंडर', and inconsistent codes make it hard to read.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends by inviting the user to choose a scheme for more info. Some follow-up, but generic.

grammar.evidence: Frequent grammatical and typographical issues: 'राष्ट्रीय तेल तेल तेल तेल', 'बूंद अंडर', 'Prakल्प' typos.

terminology.evidence: Incorrect or awkward Marathi terms for schemes and components; poor rendering of official names and codes (e.g., 'गोपीनाथ मुंडे शेतकरी आपघात सुरक्षा संग्रह').

language_purity.evidence: Heavy and unnecessary English/tool code mixing and malformed transliterations: backticks with tool names, many English fragments within Marathi sentences.

fluency.evidence: Stilted and disjointed list with repetitions and malformed entries; not a natural conversational flow for rural Marathi users.

evaluation.summary: The response lists many schemes but fails to focus on animal husbandry, includes numerous irrelevant and garbled entries, leaks internal tool names, and lacks a source citation. It is not actionable (no portal link, documents, or eligibility), and Marathi quality is poor, reducing usefulness for farmers.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No agronomic advice or chemical recommendations were given.

completeness.evidence: The response did not list any schemes, benefits, eligibility, documents, or process for purchasing a milking machine.

actionability.evidence: No next steps, portal links, or document lists were provided; only a generic deflection question.

context_fit.evidence: Dairy equipment is agriculture-allied; the agent wrongly dismissed it as outside scope. It should have provided relevant scheme information.

clarity.evidence: The Marathi sentence is clear but does not address the user’s need.

conversation_closure.evidence: A generic follow-up question was asked, but it was not specific to the user’s query and did not guide the conversation toward a solution.

grammar.evidence: Grammatically correct: 'मी फक्त शेतीशी संबंधित प्रश्नांची उत्तरे देऊ शकतो. आपल्याला शेतीबाबतची माहिती हवी आहे का?'.

language_purity.evidence: Pure Marathi without unnecessary English mixing.

fluency.evidence: Natural and fluent phrasing, though curt and unhelpful.

evaluation.summary: The assistant incorrectly refused the dairy equipment schemes query as non-agricultural, used no tools, and provided no scheme details or citations. While language quality was fine, the response failed on process, completeness, and actionability.

agristack_workflow.evidence: User asked 'माझ्या पिकासाठी कोणती शासकीय योजना आहे?' which implies eligibility/personalization. Agristack ✅ was available but not used (no PoCRA/caste/land-based filtering). The agent instead dumped a full scheme list.

term_identification.evidence: For scheme info, the agent should identify relevant scheme(s) based on the user's crop. It did not ask for crop or map to related schemes (e.g., horticulture/insurance). It merely echoed the entire catalog.

tool_sequencing.evidence: It used get_scheme_codes and then responded. However, it did not follow up with get_scheme_info/get_multiple_schemes_info for any selected schemes, leading to shallow output but no sequencing violation.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search used/needed for this scheme listing task.

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or JSON leaked. However, formatting mixes headings in Hindi/Marathi (e.g., 'योजना नाम') which slightly reduces polish.

source_alignment.evidence: While codes align to tool output, several Marathi labels are inaccurate/misleading (e.g., 'ndksp-goat-rearing' shown as 'गाई वाढवणी' instead of शेळीपालन; 'onion/garlic storage' mistranslated as 'लहान खरबूज...'). These mismatches can confuse farmers.

no_fabrication.evidence: No invented schemes or benefits were stated; content appears derived from get_scheme_codes. No timelines or subsidy guarantees were claimed.

citation_accuracy.evidence: No citation provided. Expected 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती' for scheme responses.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No agronomic chemicals or safety-sensitive advice provided.

completeness.evidence: User asked for schemes for 'my crop'. The response neither asked for the crop nor provided benefits, eligibility, documents, or application steps. It only listed schemes by name/code.

actionability.evidence: No portal URL (MahaDBT), no document checklist, no step-by-step application guidance. Only a list was provided.

context_fit.evidence: Agristack ✅ was available but not used to personalize (PoCRA status, caste, landholding). The answer is non-contextual and generic.

clarity.evidence: State vs Central sections are separated, but many names are poorly translated/mixed-language, reducing clarity. Still, the table format is readable.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a generic prompt 'योजना बद्दल अधिक माहिती विचारायचे आहे का?' but misses a targeted follow-up like asking crop type or purpose to narrow schemes.

grammar.evidence: Mostly list entries; sentence structure acceptable. Minor issues but generally understandable.

terminology.evidence: Incorrect/agriculturally inappropriate terms: 'गाई वाढवणी' for goat rearing; 'फसल प्रतियोगिता' (Hindi) instead of 'पीक स्पर्धा'; several MIDH items inconsistently labeled.

language_purity.evidence: Frequent Hindi terms ('योजना नाम', 'प्रधानमंत्री', 'फसल') and English fragments, but not excessive English technical jargon.

fluency.evidence: Reads like a raw catalog dump, not a conversational Marathi response tailored to a farmer's question.

evaluation.summary: The response lists many schemes but ignores the user’s intent for crop-specific guidance and Agristack personalization. It lacks citation, actionability, and contains several mistranslations/mixed-language scheme names, reducing clarity and trust.

question: डाळिंब किंवा मका लागवडीसाठी शासकीय योजना उपलब्ध आहेत का?
answer:
महाराष्ट्रातील शासकीय योजना आणि केंद्र सरकारच्या योजनांची यादी खाली दिलेली आहे. डाळिंब किंवा मका लागवडीसाठी उपलब्ध असलेल्या योजनांची तपासणी करा:

### महाराष्ट्र शासकीय योजना (महाराष्ट्राच्या योजना)
- **नॅनाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प - बूंद पिणी जलसंपदा** (ndksp-drip-irrigation)
- **नॅनाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प - फलक आणि फुलक लागवड** (ndksp-horticulture-plantation)
- **राष्ट्रीय खाद्य आणि पोषण सुरक्षा मिशन - बीज वितरण** (nfsnm-seed-distribution)
- **राष्ट्रीय खाद्य आणि पोषण सुरक्षा मिशन - बीज उत्पादन** (nfsnm-seed-production)
- **राष्ट्रीय खाद्य आणि पोषण सुरक्षा मिशन - शेती दर्शन** (nfsnm-crop-demonstration)
- **मुख्यमंत्री स्थायी कृषी जलसंपदा व्यक्तिगत खेत तलाव** (mahadbt-cmsaisfp)
- **नॅनाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प - शेत तलाव लाइनिंग** (ndksp-farm-pond-lining)
- **नॅनाजी देशमुख कृषी संजीवनी प्रकल्प - बीज उत्पादन** (ndksp-seed-production)

### केंद्र सरकारच्या योजना
- **मिशन फॉर इंटिग्रेटेड डेव्हलपमेंट ऑफ हॉर्टिकल्चर (MIDH)** (mahadbt-midh-area-expansion-mushroom-cultivation)
- **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि (PM-KISAN)** (mahadbt-pmkisan)
- **प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (PMFBY)** (mahadbt-pmfby)
- **अग्रिम खेती उत्पादन विकास मिशन (AIF)** (mahadbt-aif)
- **मिशन फॉर इंटिग्रेटेड डेव्हलपमेंट ऑफ हॉर्टिकल्चर (MIDH) - वृक्ष आणि फुलक लागवड** (mahadbt-midh-planting-material)

### आपल्याला अधिक माहिती हवी आहे का?
- आपण विशिष्ट योजनेबद्दल अधिक माहिती वाचू इच्छिता का?
- किंवा आपण एखाद्या शासकीय योजनेसाठी अर्ज करायचा आहे का?

question: माझ्या शेतासाठी ट्रॅक्टर किंवा हातमुद्रक यंत्रासाठी कोणत्या शासकीय योजनेचा लाभ मिळेल?
answer:
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

### 1. **राज्य संचालित कृषी मेकॅनायझेशन योजना (State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization)**  
**कोणत्या योजनेचा लाभ मिळेल?**  
या योजनेअंतर्गत शेतकऱ्यांना त्यांच्या शेतासाठी ट्रॅक्टर किंवा हातमुद्रक यंत्रासाठी आर्थिक सहाय्य मिळते.  

**लाभ (Benefits):**  
- शेतकऱ्यांना शेती यंत्रसामग्री आणि उपकरणे खरेदी करण्यासाठी आर्थिक सहाय्य मिळते.  
- आर्थिक सहाय्य दर खालीलप्रमाणे असतो:  
  - आदिवासी, शेतकरी आणि महिला शेतकरी यांसाठी 40%  
  - इतर शेतकरी यांसाठी 50%  

**पात्रता (Eligibility):**  
- व्यक्तिगत शेतकरी  

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया (Application Process):**  
- अर्ज https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in या पोर्टलवर करावा.  
- अर्ज दाखल केल्यानंतर शेतकरी खुल्या बाजारातून यंत्र खरेदी करू शकतात.  
- खरेदी वेळी शेतकरी त्यांच्या बँक खात्यातून चेक/डीडी/ऑनलाइन पेमेंट करावा.  
- आर्थिक सहाय्य शेतकऱ्याच्या आधार-लिंक बँक खात्यात डीबीटी (Direct Benefit Transfer) माध्यमातून जमा केला जातो.  

---

### 2. **केंद्रीय योजना: सब-मिशन ऑन एग्रीकल्चर मेकॅनायझेशन (Sub-Mission on Agriculture Mechanization)**  
**कोणत्या योजनेचा लाभ मिळेल?**  
या योजनेअंतर्गत शेतकऱ्यांना ट्रॅक्टर, पॉवर टिलर, ऑटोमेटेड मशीनरी, ट्रॅक्टर-चालित उपकरणे, आणि पोस्ट-हार्वेस्ट प्राथमिक प्रोसेसिंग उपकरणे यांच्यासाठी आर्थिक सहाय्य मिळते.  

**लाभ (Benefits):**  
- शेतकऱ्यांना शेती यंत्रसामग्री आणि उपकरणे खरेदी करण्यासाठी आर्थिक सहाय्य मिळते.  
- आर्थिक सहाय्य दर खालीलप्रमाणे असतो:  
  - आदिवासी, शेतकरी आणि महिला शेतकरी यांसाठी 40%  
  - इतर शेतकरी यांसाठी 50%  

**पात्रता (Eligibility):**  
- व्यक्तिगत शेतकरी  

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया (Application Process):**  
- अर्ज https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in या पोर्टलवर करावा.  
- अर्ज दाखल केल्यानंतर शेतकरी खुल्या बाजारातून यंत्र खरेदी करू शकतात.  
- खरेदी वेळी शेतकरी त्यांच्या बँक खात्यातून चेक/डीडी/ऑनलाइन पेमेंट करावा.  
- आर्थिक सहाय्य शेतकऱ्याच्या आधार-लिंक बँक खात्यात डीबीटी (Direct Benefit Transfer) माध्यमातून जमा केला जातो.  

---

### 3. **केंद्रीय योजना: नमो ड्रोन दीदी (Namo Drone Didi)**  
**कोणत्या योजनेचा लाभ मिळेल?**  
या योजनेअंतर्गत महिला स्वयंसेवी सहाय्य समूहांना ड्रोन आणि त्यांचे संबंधित उपकरणे दिले जातात.  

**लाभ (Benefits):**  
- महिला स्वयंसेवी सहाय्य समूहांना ड्रोन आणि त्यांचे संबंधित उपकरणे 80% किंवा ₹8.00 लाख अंतर्गत आर्थिक सहाय्य मिळते.  

**पात्रता (Eligibility):**  
- राज्याच्या शेती विभागाने निवडलेल्या क्लस्टरमधील महिला स्वयंसेवी सहाय्य समूहांना.  

**अर्ज प्रक्रिया (Application Process):**  
- राज्याच्या शेती विभागाने क्लस्टर निवडल्यानंतर, ग्रामीण विकास विभाग महिला स्वयंसेवी सहाय्य समूहांची निवड करतो.  

---

**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**  
आपण ट्रॅक्टर किंवा हातमुद्रक यंत्रासाठी कोणत्या योजनेचा लाभ घेण्याची इच्छा आहे?

*Id*:
61

*Scheme Code*:
sdda-farm-machinery-and-equipments

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
DDA MECHANIZATION

*Scheme Name*:
State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization

*Main Component*:
Benefit for Farm Machinery and Equipments.

*Sub Component*:
Tractors, power tillers, automated machinery, tractor-operated implements, tractor-operated crop protection implements, and post-harvest primary processing implements.

*Introduction*:
The declining number of livestock and the shortage of labor for agricultural work necessitate mechanization in agriculture. Mechanization allows work to be completed within a specified time frame, saves inputs, and saves production costs.
Objective:-
        Resolve labour issues in agriculture.
        Promote Farm Mechanization.
        Enable farmers to take up farm operations in time.
        Promote custom hiring services for farm mechanization.
        Create rural employment.
        Help to Increase agriculture production.

*Benefits*:
1. Financial assistance to farmers for procurement of farm machinery and implements
2. Generally, the subsidy is given at a rate of 40 % for SC, ST & small farmers, Womens & 50% for other farmers percent of the cost or the maximum subsidy limit declared by the Central Government, whichever is lower.

*Eligibility*:
Individual Farmer.

*Required Documents*:
1. Quotation of Implement to be purchase.
2. Test report of the Implement.
3. RC of tractor for tractor driven implements.

*Application Process*:
Applications from Interested farmers are invited on https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/ this portal. For transparency in beneficiary selection, presanction is being given by determining seniority through FCFS method. All the processes from beneficiary selection to grant payment are being implemented online.
After presanction, farmers are being allowed to purchase from the open market as per their choice. At the time of purchase, farmers are required to make payment through cheque/DD/online from their own bank account. The subsidy amount is being transferred to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the beneficiary farmer through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) method.

agristack_workflow.evidence: Agent correctly fetched Agristack (PoCRA: No, Caste: General, Latur) but did not use it to personalize eligibility/subsidy (e.g., indicate General category likely subsidy bracket) or to filter PoCRA-dependent schemes (not relevant here).

term_identification.evidence: Mapped the farmer’s need (tractor or hand sprayer) to farm mechanization schemes: State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization and Central SMAM; also mentioned Namo Drone Didi (less relevant). Did not surface MIDH sprayer-specific components despite the query mentioning 'हातमुद्रक' (hand sprayer).

tool_sequencing.evidence: Followed get_scheme_codes → get_multiple_schemes_info for relevant schemes. This is the preferred workflow for multiple related schemes.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search used/needed for schemes.

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or JSON leaked. Clean, farmer-facing presentation with proper Marathi labels and a scheme source citation.

source_alignment.evidence: Benefits and processes generally align with tool outputs (e.g., 40% for SC/ST/small/women; 50% for others; MahaDBT application; DBT). Minor omissions like 'whichever is lower' and detailed FCFS note were not explicitly stated.

no_fabrication.evidence: No invented schemes or promises. Namo Drone Didi details (80% or ₹8 lakh) match tool output; no subsidy guarantees beyond sourced text.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Used farmer-friendly citation 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती' as required.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No chemical advisories or safety-sensitive recommendations.

completeness.evidence: Covered two core mechanization schemes relevant to tractor/sprayer. Missing other relevant sprayer components under MIDH (manual sprayers categories listed in codes) and did not include required documents list present in tools.

actionability.evidence: Provided portal URL and general process. Did not list required documents (quotation, test report, RC) or clarify caps ('whichever is lower') and FCFS presanction explicitly.

context_fit.evidence: Agristack showed General category and large landholding; response could have personalized likely subsidy bracket and clarified CHC vs individual purchase. PoCRA status is irrelevant here but was not misused.

clarity.evidence: Well-structured with headings for each scheme, clear Marathi phrasing. Minor redundancy and some generic phrasing.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a specific follow-up question asking which asset the farmer plans to avail. Could have suggested specific paths for tractor vs hand sprayer.

grammar.evidence: Grammatically correct and readable Marathi throughout (e.g., 'अर्ज प्रक्रिया', 'आर्थिक सहाय्य').

terminology.evidence: Used correct terms like 'पात्रता', 'लाभ', 'अर्ज'. Could have used 'अनुदान' explicitly and 'कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर' terminology where relevant.

language_purity.evidence: Mostly Marathi with necessary scheme names in English. Minimal code-mixing.

fluency.evidence: Natural and farmer-friendly tone; minor stiffness in repeated benefit lines.

evaluation.summary: Good overall: correct schemes identified and grounded with proper citation, but missed personalization using Agristack and key actionable details (documents, caps) and omitted MIDH sprayer components relevant to hand sprayers.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Used the standard farmer-friendly citation: 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती'.

safety_compliance.evidence: No chemical or risky advice involved; purely scheme info.

completeness.evidence: Listed key state and central mechanization schemes, but omitted other relevant options (e.g., tractor/power tiller components under MIDH) and did not include benefits, eligibility, documents, portal, or process.

actionability.evidence: No MahaDBT/portal URL, no required documents, no application steps or timelines; only scheme names.

context_fit.evidence: With Agristack ❌, general information is acceptable. The response did not misapply PoCRA-only schemes or give inapplicable advice.

clarity.evidence: Well-structured with state vs central sections and bullet points; easy to read despite being brief.

conversation_closure.evidence: Did not ask follow-up (e.g., which machine) or offer next steps for application/support.

grammar.evidence: Grammatically correct sentences such as 'शेती मशीनरीच्या वापरासाठी शेतकऱ्यांना अनुदान उपलब्ध करून देण्यासाठी ही योजना आहे.'

terminology.evidence: Used some correct terms but mixed with English (e.g., 'एग्रीकल्चर मॅकेनाइजेशन', 'CHC') instead of 'कृषी यंत्रीकरण', 'कस्टम हायरिंग सेंटर'.

fluency.evidence: Readable but repetitive phrasing for each bullet, making it slightly stilted.

   - या संस्था शेती यंत्रसामग्रीचे व्यावसायिक परीक्षण करतात. हार्वेस्टर यंत्रांचे परीक्षण आणि त्यांच्या गुणवत्ता तपासली जाते.

3. **कृषी यंत्रसामग्रीचे परीक्षण आणि मूल्यांकन योजना:**
   - या योजनेच्या अंतर्गत, शेतकऱ्यांना अत्याधुनिक आणि उच्च गुणवत्तेचे हार्वेस्टर यंत्र उपलब्ध करून दिले जाते.

question: मी नवीन शेतकरी आहे, कोणत्या योजना माझ्यासाठी सर्वप्रथम उपलब्ध आहेत?
answer:
मी आपल्याला उपलब्ध असलेल्या शासकीय योजनांची माहिती देत आहे, ज्यांचा आपण लाभ घेऊ शकता:

### **महाराष्ट्र राज्य योजना (State Schemes):**
1. **नैसर्गिक तेल तेल बीज योजना (National Mission on Edible Oils – Oilseeds):** `mahadbt-nmeo-oilseeds`
2. **सिंचन योजना (Sprinkler Irrigation):** `ndksp-sprinkler-irrigation`
3. **विपरीत जमीन विकास योजना (Rainfed Area Development):** `pmrkvy-rad`
4. **खाद्य आणि पोषण सुरक्षा मिशन (National Food and Nutritional Security Mission):** `nfsnm-seed-distribution`
5. **हॉर्टिकल्चर विकास योजना (Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture):** `mahadbt-midh-green-house-poly-house`
6. **हॉर्टिकल्चर लागवड योजना (Horticulture Plantation):** `ndksp-horticulture-plantation`
7. **शेतकऱ्यांच्या आंतरराष्ट्रीय भ्रमणाची योजना (Farmer's International Study Tours):** `state-farmer-international-tour`
8. **कापूस विकास योजना (Cotton Development Scheme):** `mahadbt-nfsnm-cotton-development`
9. **शासकीय यंत्रणा विकास योजना (State Sponsored Agriculture Mechanization):** `sdda-farm-machinery-and-equipments`
10. **बांबू विकास योजना (Bamboo Development):** `ndksp-agroforestry-bamboo`

### **केंद्रीय योजना (Central Schemes):**
1. **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी (PM-KISAN):** `mahadbt-pmkisan`
2. **प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (PMFBY):** `mahadbt-pmfby`
3. **नमो शेतकरी महासंमान निधी (NSMNY):** `mahadbt-nsmnyy`
4. **महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी योजना (MGNREGS):** `mahadbt-mgnregs`
5. **प्रधानमंत्री किसान मंडन योजना (PMKMY):** `mahadbt-pmkmy`
6. **विकास आणि अग्रगण्यता योजना (Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture):** `mahadbt-midh-area-expansion-mushroom-cultivation`

ह्या योजनांची अधिक माहिती आणि अर्ज प्रक्रिया जाणून घेण्यासाठी, आपण योजनेचे नाव विचारू शकता. आपल्याला कोणती योजना जास्त उपयोगी वाटते?

term_identification.evidence: Identified and listed several relevant schemes (PM-KISAN, PMFBY, mechanization, MIDH), but not tailored to the “new farmer starter” need; missed key pairings like RWBCIS with PMFBY and Per Drop More Crop for irrigation.

tool_sequencing.evidence: get_scheme_codes was correctly called first; however, no follow-up get_scheme_info/get_multiple_schemes_info to provide details or personalize.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - reason: No document search was required or performed for this scheme listing use case.

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names leaked; only scheme names and codes shown. Minor formatting only; no internal artifacts.

source_alignment.evidence: Listed scheme names and codes align broadly with tool output. Some Marathi renderings are awkward/mistranslated (e.g., “विपरीत जमीन विकास” for RAD), but no contradictory benefits/eligibility stated.

no_fabrication.evidence: No invented benefits, timelines, or contacts. The response stays at a high level without unsupported claims.

citation_accuracy.evidence: No citation provided. Expected: “स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती.”

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - reason: No agronomic inputs or chemical recommendations provided.

completeness.evidence: Only a subset of starter schemes listed; missed RWBCIS, PM-RKVY Per Drop More Crop, SDDA/CDDA pair clarity, soil testing, and key onboarding steps. No eligibility, benefits, or documents listed.

actionability.evidence: No portal URL (MahaDBT), no document checklist, no stepwise application process. Just asks user to specify a scheme.

context_fit.evidence: With Agristack ✅, it should personalize (PoCRA status, caste, land). Also recommended multiple PoCRA (NDKSP) schemes without clarifying PoCRA requirement.

clarity.evidence: Sectioned into State vs Central with bullet points; understandable but some Marathi labels are unclear or inaccurate.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends with a follow-up question (“आपल्याला कोणती योजना…?”). However, lacks tailored next steps.

grammar.evidence: Generally grammatical Marathi; sentences are simple and readable.

terminology.evidence: Several incorrect/unnatural terms: “विपरीत जमीन विकास” for RAD, “प्रधानमंत्री किसान मंडन” (should be मानधन), “महासंमान” (should be महासन्मान), awkward “नैसर्गिक तेल तेल बीज योजना” for NMEO–Oilseeds.

fluency.evidence: Readable flow but stilted in places due to mistranslations and awkward phrasing.

## 1. Scheme Information

*Id*:
90

*Scheme Code*:
mahadbt-nfsnm-cotton-development

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSNM) Commercial Crop- Cotton Development Scheme

*Main Component*:
1) Crop Demonstration 2) Cotton Seed production 3)  Integrated Pest Management  4)  On Line Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services  5) State level training  6) Local Initiatives - a) Early termination & stubble removal demonstration b) Biochar

*Sub Component*:
1) Crop Demonstration -a) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Intercropping (Mung, Udid) , b) Trials on High Density Planting Systems , c) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Integrated Crop Management (ICM)
2) Cotton Seed production - FLD on Desi & Extra Long Staple -(ELS) cotton/ ELS cotton Seed Production
3)  Integrated Pest Management (IPM) -Distribution of plant  protection chemicals and Bio agents
4) On Line Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services (OPMAS)
5) State level training
6) Local Initiatives - Early termination & stubble removal demonstration
7) Biochar

*Introduction*:
The National Food Security Mission (NFSNM) has been implementing the cotton development programme under the commercial cotton programme since 2014-15. The scheme will be implemented under the name of National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSNM) from 2025-26. It includes measures such as early-maturing (production of extra-long staple cotton seed), early-maturing (intercropping of cotton, urad etc.), intensive larval management of straight varieties of cotton, distribution of crop protection drugs and bioagents, Online Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services (OPMAS) and state-level monitoring, field-based pest control, early-maturing and biochar. For this, the program will be implemented in the ratio of Center: State 60:40 percent. Along with foodgrains, cotton cultivation has been included in the scheme to increase the cultivation of non-food crops.

*Benefits*:
1) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Intercropping (Mung, Udid)- Rs. 8000/ha
2) Trials on High Density Planting Systems Rs. - 10000/ha
3) Front- Line Demonstation (FLD) on Integrated Crop Management (ICM) -Rs.-Rs.8000/ha.
4) Cotton Seed production - FLD on Desi & Extra Long Staple -(ELS) cotton/ ELS cotton Seed Production -Rs.9000/ha.
5)Distribution of plant  protection chemicals and Bio agents -Rs. 500/ha or 50% of the cost (whichever is less)
6) On Line Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services (OPMAS) -Rs. 8000/ha.
7) State level trainings (20 participants X 2 days) - Rs. 40000/traning.
8) Early termination & stubble removal demonstration- Rs. 5000/ha.
7) Biochar - Rs. 10000/Unit.

*Eligibility*:
1) Crop Demonstration- Group Beneficiary
2) Biachar - Indiviual
3) Traning - Agri Depaetment Staff.

*Required Documents*:
1) It is mandatory for the farmers to be given subsidy to these politicians to be registered on Agristack.
2) Farmer ID is mandatory .

*Application Process*:
1) Crop Demonstration- MAHADBT Portal
2) Biochar -MAHADBT Portal
3) Seed Production - Through SAUs


Applications are called on MahaDBT portal.
www.https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/Farmer/AgriLogin/AgriLogin.

*Source Url*:
GoI Website -http://www.nfsm.gov.in

*Id*:

*Sponsor*:
State

*Scheme Provider*:
Maha-DBT

*Scheme Name*:
National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSNM) Commercial Crop- Sugarcane Development Scheme

*Main Component*:
1) Crop Demonstration
2) Assistance for breeder seed production
3) Tissue culture plantlets
4) State level training
5) Integrated Pest Management  (IPM) -Distribution of plant protection Chemicals and Bioagents
 6)Local Initiatives-

b) Supercane Nursery

2) Assistance for breeder seed production

4) State level training (20 participants X 2 days)
5) Distribution of plant protection Chemicals and Bioagents
6) Local Initiatives-

*Introduction*:
From the year 2014-15, a sugarcane cultivation program is being implemented under the National Food Security Mission - Commercial Crops. The program will be implemented as follows: Center: State, 60: 40 percent.
Sugarcane is an important cash crop in Maharashtra. The state has favorable climate conditions for sugarcane growth. Maharashtra is leading in the country in terms of sugar production and sugar yield. But the average per hectare sugarcane productivity is low. Therefore, it is important to make sugarcane production technology accessible to maximum farmers. By reducing production costs by adding modern technology to the field, farmers will be able to get sustainable income from sugarcane cultivation. With a view to reducing the cost of sugarcane production and increasing productivity, a sugarcane expansion program is being implemented in the state under the National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSNM) in the year 2025-26.

*Benefits*:
1) Demonstration intercropping and single bud chip technology with Sugarcane -Rs. 9000/ha.

## 3. Scheme Information

*Scheme Name*:
Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana (BAKSY)

*Main Component*:
Providing Irrigation Fscilities to the eligible beneficiaries of Scheduled Cast (SC) category

*Sub Component*:
1. New Irrigation Well
2. Old Well Repair
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds
4. Inwell Boring
5. Electricity Connection
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)
7. Solar pump (instead of electrical connection Charges and pump set)
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)
9. Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) AND
     Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements)
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden

*Introduction*:
The Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan (Special Component Scheme(scp)) was being implemented from the year 1982-83 to increase the income of Scheduled Caste / New-Buddhist farmers and improve their standard of living. Since the said scheme has been implemented for a long period of time, the GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA has decided to implement the Special Component Scheme for Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist farmers since 1982-83 and the recommendations of the Agriculture Commissionerate dated 27/04/2016 on the report dated 19/04/2016 and special component scheme the announced by the Hon'ble Minister (Finance). Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana is not being implemented separately, but the current special component scheme, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana, is being implemented from 2016-17 as per the changed criteria, taking into account the needs of the changed situation and maintaining soil moisture.
Also, the government has approved the amendment in the financial criteria and inclusion of new components under the said scheme as per the government decision dated 01 October, 2024.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    beneficiary Selection criteria are as follows
1.  Scheme is only for Scheduled Caste/ Nav Baudha farmers.
2.  Scheme is implemented in all districts of Maharashtra (Except Mumbai districts).
3. At field level  scheme is under Implementation by department of Agriculture, Zilha Parishad.
4. Funds are released from Social Justice Department to concerned  District Collector and then made available to concern Zilha Parishad.
5. Application ,Selection of beneficiaries upto payment of subsidy all process are done through MAHADBT Portal through online system.                                                                  "

*Benefits*:
Benefit provided on subsidy basis as per the norms of components, through online system. The said scheme shall be implemented in the financial year 2025-26 as follows. In the said scheme, grants shall be admissible for the following components in the year 2025-26 up to the maximum limit of the amount mentioned below.
1. For New Irrigation- Well Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Rs.4,00,000/ - is admissible.
2. For Old Well Repair - Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 1,00,000/- is admissible
3. Plastic Lining of Farm Ponds-Grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the amount calculated as per the prevailing financial parameters of the National Horticulture Mission Guideline and the size of the farm pond or actual cost or Rs. 2,00,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
4.Inwell Boring- Maximum subsidy ammount limit is 40,000/- is admissible
5. Electricity Connection-Maximum subsidy ammount limit is Amount 20,000/- or actual paid amount whichever is less is admissible.
6. Pump Set (Diesel/Electric)(Diesel Engine - New Item) For pump sets up to 10 HP capacity, grant shall be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial parameters or actual cost or Rs. 40,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
7. Grant Solar pump (instead of electrical connection and pump set)- Maximum subsidy will be admissible up to 90% of the prevailing financial criteria or actual expenditure incurred or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less is admissible.
8. HDPE/PVC Pipe (New Item)- Under the Food and Nutrition Security Scheme - Food Crops Scheme, subsidy of 100% of the prevailing economic standard or actual cost incurred per meter or Rs. 50,000/- whichever is less will be admissible.
9.1 For Micro irrigation system Under Sprinkler Irrigation Set (Supplementary Grant) 9.1.1) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and9.1.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 47,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy. (Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
9.2 For Drip Irrigation Set Supplementary Grant 9.2.1 ) Under the Per Drop More Crop Scheme, (1) 55% for small/very small landholders + 25% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 10% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana and 9.2.2) 45% for large landholders + 30% from the Chief Minister's Sustainable Irrigation Scheme + 15% from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krishi Swavalamban Yojana or Rs. 97,000/- whichever is less will be admissible as subsidy.(Total subsidy limit of 90 percent) is admissible
10. Farm Machinery (bullock-drawn/tractor-drawn implements) (New item)maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible
11. Backyard / Kitchen Garden (New Item) maximum subsidy limit is 50,000/- is admissible .

*Eligibility*:
1. Scheme is only for Scheduled Tribe farmers. Caste  certificate is essential.
2. Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to  6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential)
3.1 It will be mandatory for the beneficiary to be a farmer belonging to the Scheduled Caste / Neo-Buddhist category.
3.2 The farmer must have a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
3.3 Farmers residing the Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika is necessary to have 7/12 certificate and 8A extract of land tenure in the name of the farmer. ( Outside the Nagar Panchayat, Nagarpalika and Mahanagarpalika area (Reference Government Letter No. Sankirna- 2017/Pr.No.142/3A, dated 24 April 2018))
3.4 The beneficiaries must have their own Aadhaar link active bank account .
3.5 The beneficiaries below the poverty line will be given  first priority.
3.6 The beneficiary farmer must have a minimum of 0.40 hectares and a maximum of 6 hectares of agricultural land. If the beneficiary's land is in a remote and fragmented area and two or more beneficiaries with less than 0.40 hectares of land come together and their combined land is at least 0.40 hectares, then if they sign an agreement, they will be eligible for the benefit of the scheme. Similarly, the condition of maximum 6.0 hectares of land will not be applicable to the beneficiaries below the poverty line.
3.7 Once the full benefit of the relevant scheme is taken, the benefit of this scheme will not be payable to the same beneficiary or family for the next five years. The beneficiary who has taken the benefit of the new well component will be eligible for the benefit of the old well repair component after 20 years.
If the benefit has been given under the Special Component Scheme for similar agricultural development schemes and the scheme implemented from the funds made available under the SCA of the Central Government and Article 275 (A) of the Constitution, the benefit provided under this scheme will not be admissible.

*Required Documents*:
1. Caste Certificate of SC category issued by compitant authority
2. current 7/12 report having Land holding limit is 0.20 ha. to 6.00 ha.(for benefit of New well component minimum 0.40 ha. land essential) within the period of
3 months 3.GSDA Certificates
4. There is no income limit for this scheme

*Application Process*:
Application is to done online on Mahadbt portal as follows
1. Applications from farmers are being invited for the said scheme on the Maha-DBT portal website mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/farmer/login /login and the applications received within the limit of lakhs received by the concerned talukas / blocks will be selected online on a first come, first served basis (fcfs). After selection, all the proceedings up to the payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done online. In this regard, proceedings from acceptance of application to payment of subsidy to the beneficiaries should be done as mentioned in the referenced government decision dated 04/11/2020.
2. The Agricultural Officer (Agriculture), P.S., should conduct a site inspection of the area of the beneficiary selected for the new well and old well repair on a first come, first served basis and check the technical feasibility. After the inspection, if the location of the beneficiary's new well and the proposal for repair of the old well of the beneficiary is technically suitable, the Agricultural Development Officer should approve the budget for this matter and give prior approval to the proposals of the concerned beneficiary within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents. Similarly, the selection of the beneficiaries whose proposals are found to be technically unsuitable during the site inspection should be cancelled.
3. Beneficiaries selected for other matters other than new well and old well repair under the scheme should be given prior approval within a maximum of 30 days after uploading the documents and they should be given the benefit of the scheme in the current financial year 2025-26 itself.
4. The prior approval of the beneficiaries who do not implement the matters under the scheme within the prescribed period should be cancelled.
5. While selecting individual beneficiary, priority will be given to women and disabled beneficiaries. Out of the total sanctioned funds, 5 percent of the funds should be given priority to be spent on disabled beneficiaries and 30 percent of the funds should be spent on women beneficiaries.
6. As per the demand of the final selected beneficiaries as per the target of the taluka & district, a draft plan of the district should be prepared within 7 days as per Appendix No. 1, component-wise and beneficiary-wise. The responsibility of preparing the draft plan will be the responsibility of the Agricultural Development Officer.

agristack_workflow.evidence: Agent fetched Agristack (ST, PoCRA: No, 0.68 ha, Nandurbar) but did not use it to personalize eligibility or filter PoCRA-only schemes; response remained generic.

term_identification.evidence: User asked for schemes beneficial for soybean and cotton. Agent surfaced cotton scheme but also added Sugarcane scheme (irrelevant) and missed soybean-relevant schemes like NMEOS (oilseeds) and crop insurance (PMFBY/RWBCIS).

tool_sequencing.evidence: Correctly used get_scheme_codes followed by get_multiple_schemes_info for several schemes.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search in this task

output_hygiene.evidence: No tool names or JSON leaked; however the BAKSY eligibility section devolved into long, repeated text making the output messy.

source_alignment.evidence: For Sugarcane scheme, agent repeated cotton-like benefits and omitted key sugarcane-specific benefits (e.g., tissue culture Rs.3.5/seedling). For BAKSY, amounts were presented with '/hectare' which is not aligned to tool's 'maximum subsidy limit' wording; also eligibility conflation.

no_fabrication.evidence: Schemes exist in tools, but some details were generalized or incorrect (e.g., copied cotton benefits to sugarcane, mislabeling benefits as per-hectare for well subsidy). No explicit invention of new schemes.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Cited 'स्रोत: राज्य योजना माहिती' instead of the standard 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती' for scheme information; no specific portal/source URLs provided.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No chemical or safety advisories provided

completeness.evidence: Missed soybean-focused schemes (NMEOS–Oilseeds), did not include PMFBY/RWBCIS or PMKISAN/NSMNY (despite fetching NSMNY), and added an irrelevant Sugarcane scheme. No document list, no comparison or prioritization.

actionability.evidence: Generic instruction 'MAHADBT वर अर्ज करा' without direct URL, timelines, or required documents; no clear next steps tailored to the farmer.

context_fit.evidence: Did not use Agristack to note ST category, small land size (0.68 ha), or PoCRA=No to filter PoCRA-only schemes; district (Nandurbar) relevance for cotton scheme was not highlighted.

clarity.evidence: Translation/terminology errors (e.g., 'प्राणी नियंत्रण' for pest control), and a very long repetitive 'पात्रता' block under BAKSY reduced readability.

conversation_closure.evidence: No follow-up question to refine needs (e.g., irrigation, machinery, insurance) or offer related schemes; conversation ended abruptly.

grammar.evidence: Multiple awkward/incorrect phrases and a severely repeated eligibility line indicate poor grammatical control.

terminology.evidence: Used incorrect agricultural terms: 'प्राणी नियंत्रण' instead of 'कीड नियंत्रण', 'कुंड' instead of 'विहीर'; inconsistent scheme terminology.

language_purity.evidence: Mostly Marathi with acceptable use of scheme acronyms; limited unnecessary English.

fluency.evidence: Output was disfluent with extremely long, duplicated text in BAKSY eligibility; hampers comprehension.

evaluation.summary: The response partially identified a relevant cotton scheme but missed key soybean-related and universal-benefit schemes, and even included an irrelevant sugarcane scheme. Personalization from Agristack was not used, several details did not align with tool outputs, and Marathi quality suffered due to terminology errors and excessive repetition.

agristack_workflow.evidence: Agristack was available but the query was general scheme info; the assistant did not fetch Agristack for personalization, which is acceptable though missed an opportunity to check PoCRA status for NDKSP.

term_identification.evidence: Mapped 'organic farming' to ndksp-organic-production-unit (relevant) but then listed multiple NFSNM entries and labeled them as organic/biological-oriented benefits without clear linkage. Several entries are duplicated and generic (e.g., multiple 'nfsnm-inm-ipm' and 'nfsnm-crop-demonstration').

tool_sequencing.evidence: Only get_scheme_codes was used; the assistant did not follow up with get_scheme_info or get_multiple_schemes_info to retrieve grounded details before responding, leading to generic/assumed benefits.

search_quality.evidence: N/A - No document search was required or performed for scheme info.

output_hygiene.evidence: No internal tool names leaked and no raw JSON shown. However, there is clutter due to repeated sections (items 6-10 repeat earlier content), reducing hygiene.

source_alignment.evidence: Benefits like 'provides equipment, technology and training' for ndksp-organic-production-unit and describing NFSNM schemes as supporting 'jāivik/organic' are not grounded in any fetched scheme_info. With only scheme codes retrieved, these claims are unverified.

no_fabrication.evidence: Several inferred benefits/eligibility statements (e.g., 'all farmers eligible', 'organic seeds support') are asserted without tool-backed details; repetition suggests filler content rather than sourced facts.

citation_accuracy.evidence: Cited 'स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती' which matches the expected farmer-friendly source label for scheme information.

safety_compliance.evidence: N/A - No chemical or dosage advice was given.

completeness.evidence: Lists a few relevant schemes but misses broader coverage and distinctions (e.g., PoCRA eligibility for NDKSP). Does not summarize benefits, eligibility, documents, and process comprehensively; duplicates inflate list without adding content.

actionability.evidence: No MahaDBT portal URL provided; guidance is mostly 'contact district agriculture office.' Documents mentioned are generic; no step-by-step process or timelines (which is good to avoid promises) but overall weak actionability.

context_fit.evidence: Agristack was available but not used to check PoCRA status; NDKSP requires PoCRA villages. The response does not clarify this condition, risking misdirection for non-PoCRA farmers.

clarity.evidence: Multiple repeated sections (items 6-10) and generic phrasing like 'आवश्यकता प्रबंधन' make it hard to follow and assess differences between schemes.

conversation_closure.evidence: Ends without offering to check eligibility based on the user's profile or asking follow-up questions (e.g., whether the village is PoCRA, what crop/system they plan to convert to organic).

grammar.evidence: Generally correct sentences, but stylistically repetitive. Minor issues present but understandable.

terminology.evidence: Uses mixed or non-standard terms like 'आवश्यकता प्रबंधन' instead of accepted Marathi terms (उदा., 'एकात्मिक पोषण व्यवस्थापन' for INM, 'एकात्मिक कीड व्यवस्थापन' for IPM).

language_purity.evidence: Mostly Marathi with scheme names in English (acceptable). Some Hindi-influenced phrasing persists.

fluency.evidence: Repetitive listings and duplicated items break natural flow; lacks cohesive structure and transitions.

evaluation.summary: The response identifies one clearly relevant scheme but mostly provides repetitive, generic, and weakly grounded information without fetching detailed scheme data. It misses PoCRA eligibility clarification and actionable steps like MahaDBT portal link, reducing usefulness and clarity.

question: लहान शेतकऱ्यांसाठी कोणत्या योजनांमध्ये अनुदान जास्त मिळते?
answer:
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

### 1. **प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधी योजना (PMKISAN)**  
- **कोणत्या योजनेचा फायदा मिळतो?**  
  ₹6,000 प्रति कुटुंब प्रति वर्ष, तीन वर्षांत 3 भागांमध्ये ₹2,000 प्रति भाग.  
- **कोण योग्य आहे?**  
  खेत धारक किसान कुटुंब, ज्यांच्याकडे कामगार खेत असते.  
- **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**  
  7/12 एक्स्ट्रॅक्ट, आधार कार्ड, बँक खाते तपशील.  
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**  
  [pmkisan.gov.in](https://pmkisan.gov.in) वर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा.  

---

### 2. **प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (PMFBY)**  
- **कोणत्या योजनेचा फायदा मिळतो?**  
  खेती नुकसानाच्या विरुद्ध 70% विमा आणि आर्थिक सहाय्य.  
- **कोण योग्य आहे?**  
  ज्यांच्याकडे जाहीर केलेली फसली असते.  
- **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**  
  आधार कार्ड, बँक खाते, खेत आणि फसली तपशील.  
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**  
  [pmfby.gov.in](https://pmfby.gov.in) वर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा.  

---

### 3. **प्रधानमंत्री किसान मंडल योजना (PMKMY)**  
- **कोणत्या योजनेचा फायदा मिळतो?**  
  ₹3,000 मासिक निवृत्ती फायदा (60 वर्षांनंतर).  
- **कोण योग्य आहे?**  
  18 ते 40 वर्षांचे लहान आणि मार्जिनल किसान.  
- **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**  
  7/12 एक्स्ट्रॅक्ट.  
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**  
  [pmkmy.gov.in](https://pmkmy.gov.in) वर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा.  

---

### 4. **कृषि बुन्निंग फंड (AIF)**  
- **कोणत्या योजनेचा फायदा मिळतो?**  
  बँक लोनसाठी 3% व्याज छूट आणि 2 कोटी रुपयांपर्यंत व्याज गारंटी.  
- **कोण योग्य आहे?**  
  प्राथमिक आणि दुसरा पोस्ट-हार्वेस्ट इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर विकासासाठी लोन अर्ज करणारे.  
- **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**  
  लोन प्रस्ताव आणि बँक द्वारे स्वीकृती.  
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**  
  स्वीकृत बँक द्वारे अर्ज करा.  

---

### 5. **PM-RKVY-Per Drop More Crop (PDMC)**  
- **कोणत्या योजनेचा फायदा मिळतो?**  
  ड्रिप आणि स्प्रिंकलर इरिगेशन सिस्टमच्या खर्चाचा 55% अनुदान.  
- **कोण योग्य आहे?**  
  7/12 आणि 8A धारक किसान आणि इरिगेशन स्रोत असलेले.  
- **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**  
  महाडीबीटी पोर्टल रजिस्ट्रेशन.  
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**  
  [mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in](https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in) वर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा.  

---

### 6. **कृषि संगठन विकास योजना (MIDH)**  
- **कोणत्या योजनेचा फायदा मिळतो?**  
  फल, शाक आणि फुलांच्या क्षेत्र विस्तारासाठी आर्थिक सहाय्य.  
- **कोण योग्य आहे?**  
  महाडीबीटी पोर्टल रजिस्ट्रेशन असलेले.  
- **आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:**  
  महाडीबीटी पोर्टल रजिस्ट्रेशन.  
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:**  
  [mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in](https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in) वर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा.  

---

### कोणत्या योजनांमध्ये लहान शेतकऱ्यांना जास्त अनुदान मिळते?  
- **PMKISAN, PMFBY, PMKMY, AIF, PDMC, MIDH** या योजनांमध्ये लहान शेतकऱ्यांना जास्त अनुदान आणि आर्थिक सहाय्य मिळते.  
- आपण ज्या योजनांमध्ये अर्ज करू शकता, त्यांची तपासणी करू इच्छिता का?

*Main Component*:
Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojna (PMFBY)

*Sub Component*:
Risk covered -  Crop cutting base average yield reduction in comparison to threshhold yield for that insurance unit( Revenue circle)

*Introduction*:
1. The scheme is applicable for notified crops in a notified area (revenue circle). All farmers including share-croppers, tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified area.
2. The scheme is optional for both loanee as well as non-loanee  farmers.
3. Under this scheme, the indemnity level is  fixed as 70 % for all notified crops.
4. Threshold yield  is determined by taking into account the average average yield  of the  best five years from past 7 years multiplied by  indemnity level
5. The scheme is implemented on beed pattern (80:110) where Insurance companies claim liability is up to 110 %  of the gross premium  or 110% of the burn cost whichever is higher for the given cluster in given season .  The claims above 110 % will be paid by state govt. and in case of profit, Insurance company will keep 20% of the gross premium and return the balance premium amount to state if any .

*Benefits*:
Provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of  crop failure due to natural calamaties, pests and disease so as to restore credit worthiness for ensuring season.

*Eligibility*:
1. All the farmers  growing notified crops in the notified area are eligible.
2. The scheme is  optional for Loanee & Non-loanee farmers.

Sum insured per hector: Sum insured per hectare is decided as per scale of finance for that crop

Insurance Companies: The scheme is being implemented through selected  crop insurance companies  through tendering process.

*Required Documents*:
1. Agristack number
2. Aadhar card
3. Bank account details
4. Land details and crop details
5. Digital crop survey ( E pik Pahani)

Application is to done online on www.pmfby.gov.in portal within the given date

question: माझ्या शेतात नवीन ड्रिप प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी अर्ज कसा करावा?
answer:
माफ करा, मला "अर्ज कसा करावा" बद्दल खास माहिती मिळालेली नाही. पण ड्रिप प्रणाली बसवण्यासाठी अर्ज करण्यासाठी, आपण आपल्या जिल्ह्याच्या कृषी विभागाशी संपर्क साधू शकता किंवा आपल्या शेताच्या जवळच्या कृषी विज्ञान केंद्राशी (KVK) बोलू शकता. त्यांच्याकडून आपण अर्ज करण्याची प्रक्रिया आणि आवश्यक कागदपत्रे शिकू शकता. 

आपण जवळच्या KVK केंद्राची माहिती मिळविण्यासाठी मला विचारू शकता. आपल्याला त्यासाठी मदत हवी आहे का?

question: Me PDMC yojana la eligible ahe ka?
answer:
**Pradhanmantri Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana (PMKISAN)**  
**स्रोत: शासकीय योजना माहिती**

या योजनेअंतर्गत, शेती करणाऱ्या आणि शेतीचे जमीन धारक असलेल्या शेतकऱ्यांच्या कुटुंबांना प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 चा लाभ दिला जातो. हा लाभ तीन बरोबरीच्या भागांमध्ये ₹2,000 प्रति भाग दिला जातो. या योजनेचा लाभ घेण्यासाठी शेतकऱ्याची नोंदणी करणे आवश्यक आहे.

### लाभ:
- प्रति कुटुंब प्रति वर्ष ₹6,000 चा लाभ (तीन भागांमध्ये ₹2,000 प्रति भाग)

### पात्रता:
- आर्थिकदृष्ट्या कमकुवत शेतकऱ्यांचे कुटुंब ज्यांच्याकडे शेतीचे जमीन धारक असते.

### आवश्यक कागदपत्रे:
- शेतकऱ्याची नोंदणी (7/12 एक्स्ट्रॅक्ट, जमीन लागू, आधार लागू, आणि e-KYC).

### अर्ज प्रक्रिया:
- [pmkisan.gov.in](https://pmkisan.gov.in) वेबसाइटवर ऑनलाइन अर्ज करा.

कोणत्याही अधिक माहितीसाठी, आपण आपल्या स्थानिक कृषी कार्यालयाशी संपर्क साधू शकता.

question: मी माझ्या शेतामध्ये कापसाची लागवड करण्याची योजना आखत आहे. यासाठी मी पात्र असलेल्या कोणत्याही शासकीय योजना आहेत का?
answer:
**महाराष्ट्रातील शेतकऱ्यांसाठी कापसाच्या लागवडीसाठी उपलब्ध असलेल्या योजना:**

### 1. **राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा आणि पोषण मिशन (NFSNM) - कापूस विकास योजना (mahadbt-nfsnm-cotton-development)**
- **विवरण:** या योजनेअंतर्गत कापूस लागवडीचे अभ्यास, कापूस बीज उत्पादन, एकीकृत कीटक नियंत्रण, ऑनलाइन कीटक नियंत्रण आणि सल्ला, राज्य स्तरीय प्रशिक्षण आणि अतिवास्तविक उपाय यांचा समावेश आहे.
- **लाभ:** 
  - अभ्यास (मुंग, उडीद) - ₹8000/हेक्टर
  - उच्च घनता लागवडीचा परीक्षण - ₹10000/हेक्टर
  - एकीकृत शेती प्रबंधन (ICM) - ₹8000/हेक्टर
  - कापूस बीज उत्पादन - ₹9000/हेक्टर
  - कीटक नियंत्रण औषधे आणि जैव एजंट - ₹500/हेक्टर
  - ऑनलाइन कीटक नियंत्रण आणि सल्ला - ₹8000/हेक्टर
  - राज्य स्तरीय प्रशिक्षण - ₹40000/प्रशिक्षण
  - अतिवास्तविक उपाय आणि कापूस निकाल - ₹5000/हेक्टर
  - बायोचार - ₹10000/युनिट
- **पात्रता:** शेतकरी समूह, व्यक्तिगत, आग्रिकल विभाग कर्मचारी
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** [MAHADBT पोर्टल](https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/Farmer/AgriLogin/AgriLogin)

---

### 2. **डॉ. बाबासाहेब अंबेडकर कृषी स्वावलंबन योजना (BAKSY) (mahadbt-baksy)**
- **विवरण:** या योजनेअंतर्गत जातीय शेतकऱ्यांना अतिरिक्त वित्तीय सहाय्याचे विविध घटक उपलब्ध करून देते.
- **लाभ:**
  - नवीन जलस्रोत खोदका - ₹4,00,000/हेक्टर
  - जुना जलस्रोत बराबरी - ₹1,00,000/हेक्टर
  - खेत तलावाचे प्लास्टिक लेपन - ₹2,00,000/हेक्टर
  - जलस्रोत खोदका - ₹40,000/हेक्टर
  - विद्युत संयोजन - ₹20,000/हेक्टर
  - पंप सेट (डीजेल/विद्युत) - ₹40,000/हेक्टर
  - सौर पंप - ₹50,000/हेक्टर
  - HDPE/PVC पाईप - ₹50,000/हेक्टर
  - सिंचन प्रणाली (स्प्रिंकलर/ड्रॉप) - ₹47,000/हेक्टर
  - खेत यंत्रसामग्री - ₹50,000/हेक्टर
  - बैकग्राउंड/किचन बागायत - ₹50,000/हेक्टर
- **पात्रता:** जातीय शेतकरी, नवबौद्ध शेतकरी, 0.20 हेक्टर ते 6.00 हेक्टर जमीन असलेले
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** [MAHADBT पोर्टल](https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in/Farmer/AgriLogin/AgriLogin)

---

### 3. **नमो शेतकरी महासंमान निधी (NSMNY) (mahadbt-nsmnyy)**
- **विवरण:** पीएमकिसान योजनेचे लाभ घेणारे शेतकरी या योजनेचे लाभ घेऊ शकतात.
- **लाभ:** ₹6000/वर्ष/कुटुंब, 3 समान इंस्टॉलमेंटमध्ये
- **पात्रता:** पीएमकिसान योजनेचे लाभ घेणारे
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** कोणताही अर्ज आवश्यक नाही. पीएमकिसान योजनेचे लाभ घेणारे शेतकरी स्वत:च या योजनेचे लाभ घेऊ शकतात.

---

### 4. **कृषिनाथ योजना - एकीकृत हॉर्टिकल्चर विकास (MIDH) (mahadbt-midh-area-expansion-mushroom-cultivation)**
- **विवरण:** या योजनेअंतर्गत काही घटक उपलब्ध आहेत ज्यामध्ये शेती विस्तार, केंद्रीय कार्यक्रम, शिक्षण आणि बाजाराचे व्यवस्थापन आहे.
- **लाभ:**
  - उत्पादन यूनिट - ₹30 लाख/यूनिट
  - बीज उत्पादन यूनिट - ₹20 लाख/यूनिट
  - कंपोस्ट उत्पादन यूनिट - ₹30 लाख/यूनिट
  - कम खर्चाचे बेल उत्पादन यूनिट - ₹1 लाख/यूनिट
- **पात्रता:** शेतकरी, शेतकरी समूह, सहकारी संस्था, व्यापार संघटना
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** [MAHADBT पोर्टल](https://mahectaredbt.maharashtra.gov.in)

---

### 5. **मिशन फॉर इंटीग्रेटेड डेव्हलपमेंट ऑफ हॉर्टिकल्चर (MIDH) - बी जात आणि नियंत्रण (mahadbt-midh-pollinatation)**
- **विवरण:** या योजनेअंतर्गत फल आणि सब्जी उत्पादनाच्या विकासासाठी चूल उत्पादन आणि वितरणाचे साधन उपलब्ध आहे.
- **लाभ:**
  - 8 फ्रेम बी जात बॉक्स - ₹800/हेक्टर
  - बी जात बॉक्स - ₹800/हेक्टर
  - बी जात उपकरणे - ₹8000/हेक्टर
- **पात्रता:** फल आणि सब्जी शेती करणारे शेतकरी, बी जात प्रशिक्षण प्रमाणपत्र असलेले
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** [MAHADBT पोर्टल](https://mahectaredbt.maharashtra.gov.in)

---

### 6. **मिशन फॉर इंटीग्रेटेड डेव्हलपमेंट ऑफ हॉर्टिकल्चर (MIDH) - कोल्ड स्टोरेज (mahadbt-midh-cs-1-onion, mahadbt-midh-cs-2, mahadbt-midh-cs-2-ca, mahadbt-midh-cs-3, mahadbt-midh-cs-4)**
- **विवरण:** या योजनेअंतर्गत विविध प्रकारचे कोल्ड स्टोरेज उपलब्ध आहेत ज्यामध्ये बीट, अंडी, शेंगदाणा, अंडी आणि अन्य उत्पादनांचे भंडारण आहे.
- **लाभ:**
  - कोल्ड स्टोरेज टाइप 1 (बीट) - ₹168 लाख/हेक्टर
  - कोल्ड स्टोरेज टाइप 2 - ₹210 लाख/हेक्टर
  - कोल्ड स्टोरेज टाइप 2-CA (कंट्रोल्ड एटमोस्फियर) - ₹210 लाख/हेक्टर
  - कोल्ड स्टोरेज टाइप 3 (रिपेनिंग) - ₹1.00 लाख/मीटर
  - कोल्ड स्टोरेज टाइप 4 (शेंगदाणा आणि खरबूज) - ₹168 लाख/हेक्टर
- **पात्रता:** उद्यमी, शेतकरी समूह, सहकारी संस्था, शेतकरी उत्पादन संघटना
- **अर्ज प्रक्रिया:** [MAHADBT पोर्टल](https://mahectaredbt.maharashtra.gov.in)

---

### अतिरिक्त माहिती:
- **योजनांचे विवरण:** [MAHADBT पोर्टल](https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in)
- **संपर्क विभाग:** शेती विभाग, तालुका विकास समिती, जिल्हा विकास समिती

कापूस लागवडीसाठी या योजनांचा लाभ घेण्यासाठी आपण [MAHADBT पोर्टल](https://mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in) वर जाऊ शकता. आपल्या जमीन आणि उत्पादन आवश्यकता विचारात घेऊन योजना निवडा. आपल्याला कोणत्याही योजनेची अधिक माहिती आवश्यक असल्यास, मला विचारा.

*Introduction*:
The National Food Security Mission (NFSNM) has been implementing the cotton development programme under the commercial cotton programme since 2014-15. The scheme will be implemented under the name of National Food Security and Nutrition Mission (NFSNM) from 2025-26. It includes measures such as early-maturing (production of extra-long staple cotton seed), early-maturing (intercropping of cotton, urad etc.), intensive larval management of straight varieties of cotton, distribution of crop protection drugs and bioagents, Online Pest Monitoring and Advisory Services (OPMAS) and state-level monitoring, field-based pest control, early-maturing and biochar. For this, the program will be implemented in the ratio of Center: State 60:40 percent. Along with foodgrains, cotton cultivation has been included in the scheme to increase the cultivation of non-food crops.
